violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried eggs=50, 47F, pork sausage=46, 44F, turkey sausage=50,44f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All discarded during the inspection

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED BOTTLES OF SAUCES AND SHAKERS WITH SPICES THROUGHOUT SERVING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM TO LABEL ALL BOTTLES AND SHAKERS WITH FOOD NAME.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED STIRRERS STORED IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER NEAR COFFEE STATION.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM REMOVED STIRRERS FROM CONTAINER OF WATER. CFM STATED IT IS PRACTICE TO STORE STIRRERS IN DRY CONTAINER.
